title: sqlite 在线备份（Connection.backup）+ 恢复一致性校验
expected_output:
=== sqlite 在线备份 + 恢复一致性校验 ===
源库   表名集合 = ['orders', 'users']
备份库 表名集合 = ['orders', 'users']
表名集合一致 = True
源库   行数 = {'orders': 4, 'users': 3}
备份库 行数 = {'orders': 4, 'users': 3}
行数一致 = True
源库   内容校验和 = 7b33a4063be1179b756d6b4fb895c48b6527957b4fab9d70a548576ec9d37dea
备份库 内容校验和 = 7b33a4063be1179b756d6b4fb895c48b6527957b4fab9d70a548576ec9d37dea
内容校验和一致 = True
备份完成后源库新增订单 105: 源库订单行数 = 5  备份库订单行数 = 4
备份库仍是备份时刻快照(未被污染) = True
结论: 在线备份得到的是「备份开始时刻」的一致性快照
code:
import sqlite3, hashlib

DDL = """
CREATE TABLE users(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, level INT);
CREATE TABLE orders(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, uid INT NOT NULL, amount INT NOT NULL);
"""


def fill(con):
    con.executemany("INSERT INTO users(id,name,level) VALUES (?,?,?)",
                    [(1, "alice", 3), (2, "bob", 1), (3, "carol", 2)])
    con.executemany("INSERT INTO orders(id,uid,amount) VALUES (?,?,?)",
                    [(101, 1, 500), (102, 1, 320), (103, 2, 80), (104, 3, 640)])
    con.commit()


def tables_of(con):
    return sorted(r[0] for r in con.execute(
        "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name"))


def rows_of(con, t):
    return con.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM %s" % t).fetchone()[0]


def digest(con, tables):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    for t in tables:
        h.update(("T:" + t).encode("utf-8"))
        for row in con.execute("SELECT * FROM %s ORDER BY id" % t):
            h.update(repr(tuple(row)).encode("utf-8"))
        h.update(b"|")
    return h.hexdigest()


print("=== sqlite 在线备份 + 恢复一致性校验 ===")
src = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
src.executescript(DDL)
fill(src)

dst = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
src.backup(dst)          # 在线备份: 源库加共享读锁, 分页复制到目标库

st, dt = tables_of(src), tables_of(dst)
print("源库   表名集合 =", st)
print("备份库 表名集合 =", dt)
print("表名集合一致 =", st == dt)

src_rows = {t: rows_of(src, t) for t in st}
dst_rows = {t: rows_of(dst, t) for t in dt}
print("源库   行数 =", src_rows)
print("备份库 行数 =", dst_rows)
print("行数一致 =", src_rows == dst_rows)

sd, dd = digest(src, st), digest(dst, dt)
print("源库   内容校验和 =", sd)
print("备份库 内容校验和 =", dd)
print("内容校验和一致 =", sd == dd)

src.execute("INSERT INTO orders(id,uid,amount) VALUES (105,3,999)")
src.commit()
print("备份完成后源库新增订单 105: 源库订单行数 =", rows_of(src, "orders"),
      " 备份库订单行数 =", rows_of(dst, "orders"))
print("备份库仍是备份时刻快照(未被污染) =", rows_of(dst, "orders") == 4)
print("结论: 在线备份得到的是「备份开始时刻」的一致性快照")
